1.sahih_international: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
1.pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
1.yusuf_ali: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
1.shakir: When there comes the help of Allah and the victory,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), when help and victory comes from God,
1.mohsin_khan: When comes the Help of Allah (to you, O Muhammad (Peace be upon him) against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah),
1.arberry: When comes the help of God, and victory,

2.sahih_international: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
2.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
2.yusuf_ali: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
2.shakir: And you see men entering the religion of Allah in companies,
2.muhammad_sarwar: you will see large groups of people embracing the religion of God.
2.mohsin_khan: And you see that the people enter Allah's religion (Islam) in crowds,
2.arberry: and thou seest men entering God's religion in throngs,

3.sahih_international: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
3.pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
3.yusuf_ali: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
3.shakir: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness; surely He is oft-returning (to mercy).
3.muhammad_sarwar: Glorify your Lord with praise and ask Him for forgivenes. He accepts repentance.
3.mohsin_khan: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask for His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and forgives.
3.arberry: then proclaim the praise of thy Lord, and seek His forgiveness; for He turns again unto men.
